title: "Software"

Open-source software, packages, and interactive applications developed and maintained by the group.

## R packages

### tmleMulti

Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation for **multicausal** treatment effects in the potential outcomes framework. Supports multivalued treatments with Super Learner nuisance estimation, cross-fitting, and influence-function-based variance estimation, alongside competitor estimators (Double Machine Learning, overlap-weighted IPW, and G-computation).

- Source: [github.com/migariane/tmleMulti](https://github.com/migariane/tmleMulti)
- Reference: [migariane.github.io/tmleMulti](https://migariane.github.io/tmleMulti)

Co-authored by Gustavo Rivas Gervilla (PhD student, this group) and Miguel Ángel Luque Fernández (senior author).

### BioEstatR

Classical biostatistics routines for the health sciences — companion package to *Matemática Estadística Médica con R* (probability, inference, regression, epidemiology).

- Reference: [migariane.github.io/BioEstatR](https://migariane.github.io/BioEstatR/)

## Stata packages

- **[eltmle](https://github.com/migariane/meltmle)** — Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation for the average treatment effect, with Super Learner ensemble learning.
- **[cvAUROC](https://github.com/migariane/cvAUROC)** — Cross-validated area under the ROC curve with bootstrap confidence intervals.
- **[cmatch](https://github.com/migariane/cmatch)** — Tabulation of matched pairs in 1:1 matched case-control studies.

## Interactive Shiny apps

- [Desigualdades Sociales en Andalucía (RENTA)](https://watzile.shinyapps.io/RENTA/) — interactive map of income and sociodemographic variables by census tract in Andalusia (2015–2022).
- [Expected Date of Delivery](https://watzile.shinyapps.io/ExpectedDateDelivery/) — calculate an expected delivery date from gestational age, with uncertainty intervals.
- [Pattern of Comorbidities in Cancer](https://watzile.shinyapps.io/CoMCoR/) — interactive network visualisation of comorbidity patterns among cancer patients.
- [Parametric Distributions: Time-to-Event](https://watzile.shinyapps.io/Pardist/) — explore Weibull, log-normal, and Gompertz survival distributions.
- [Colliders in Epidemiology](https://watzile.shinyapps.io/EpiCollider/) — a visual demonstration of collider and selection bias.
- [Central Limit Theorem Explorer](https://watzile.shinyapps.io/TeoreCLT/) — see the CLT emerge by repeated sampling.
- [Confidence Intervals Explorer](https://watzile.shinyapps.io/IntervalosConfianza/) — how sample size, variability, and confidence level affect interval width.

## Books

- [Computational Causal Inference for Applied Researchers](https://migariane.github.io/Causal-Inference-Book/) — open-access book (R and Stata).
- [Mathematical Statistics with R](https://github.com/migariane/MatematicaEstadisticaMedicinaR) — open-access textbook (Spanish).
- [Advanced Methods for Biostatistics (Bioestadística Aplicada)](https://migariane.github.io/Bioestadistica/) — applied biostatistics (Spanish).
